question: Should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105807 be the canonical implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/105803?
rationale: Both appear linked to the same remaining static-config gap, and choosing which contributor branch to land is a maintainer integration decision rather than a code defect automation can resolve safely.

options.title: Land this proven branch

options.title: Prefer the earlier linked branch
options.body: Use the other open PR only if its current patch, proof, and maintainability are at least as strong, then close this PR as superseded.
